response.justification: Bogdan has strong software development experience and demonstrates expertise in multiple languages and domains, including geospatial work (GISCollective) and distributed systems. However, his primary expertise does not align closely with the required modern C++/Rust focus for routing tiling, and his recent roles emphasize web/mobile development rather than low-latency geospatial data pipelines. His geospatial experience is notable but may not directly translate to the rigorous quality assurance and high-performance routing systems required.
strengths: Extensive experience with geospatial data and platforms (GISCollective, Green Map)
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
Demonstrated ability to build scalable systems (handling millions of requests at Dunnhumby)
concerns: Limited direct experience with modern C++ or Rust for low-latency routing systems
Geospatial experience is more focused on web-based platforms than data pipelines
No clear evidence of working with navigation guidance solutions or routing tiles
